code:
CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),
IsActive  BIT       NOT NULL DEFAULT (1)
caption: Omit both columns from the INSERT and SQL Server fills them in automatically.
A DEFAULT only kicks in when the column is left out entirely — not when NULL is written explicitly.
Naming it explicitly gives you something predictable to reference later.

subtitle: A column calculated from other columns, not stored by default.
